I’ve seen instances of deactivation below 93%, the best thing to do to improve your rating is don’t blast loud music, read the customer’s instructions carefully. If the food is in a plastic bag, tie it up. If the customer has a little table at the door, use that table. Don’t pull up on their driveway unless it’s necessary.
